components.notes: Private Sales route with server-paged host, task and opportunity queries; account, task, activity and opportunity changes use revision checks and request receipts.
Private contact and evidence views with explicit account/contact restriction decisions and draft readiness boundary.

Owner-reviewed private synthetic demo setup and revocable invitations; grants remain only in memory. Owner exact recipient/preview opt-in with independent sharing revision, explicit expiry and withdrawal; pending wording needs normal blueprint review.
CSV mapping and explicit server preview before each bounded import batch is applied.
Shared admin feedback provider. Preview coverage is not required because it wraps the app context rather than rendering a standalone surface.

People (board AdminPeople) in the quiet register: search by name, phone or user id, run only when submitted because each search is logged, results in a CatchTable on the queue pattern and the person beside them.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the People search controller; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_people.

Settings (boards AdminSettings*) on the list-detail pattern: settings pages as navigation and the open page beside them. Areas add their own pages through the app; Team and roles is drawn here. It replaces the Admin roles screen.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the Team controller and the settings URL seam; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_settings.
Team and roles (board AdminSettingsTeam): the people with an Admin job, what each of the three jobs can do, inviting by user id, and a sheet to change someone's job with a review note.
Settings → Safety (board AdminSettingsSafety): the steps and who may take them, the rules, the deadlines, the report reasons, the grievance officer and record keeping; only the owner edits.
Lazy live wrapper owns the safety settings controller for the Settings → Safety page; deterministic visual coverage remains on workspace_safety_settings.
Route wrapper owns the bounded adminListActionExecutions query. The employee monitor is read-only and never exposes stored request or response bodies.
Prop-driven agent activity workspace used by the route and deterministic Storybook preview; paging and local filters remain controller-owned.
Route wrapper owns TanStack Query controller; preview renders the shared DataQualityScreen preview workspace with deterministic source/state/detail fixtures in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.
Prop-driven Data Quality workspace surface used by the route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; controller-owned query logic stays in DataQualityScreen.

The editors the event page's tabs host: a Catch event's canonical editor (Page) or an imported event's source record and takedown (Takedown). The Events directory replaced its directory and External inventory lists; preview renders the registered EventPublishingWorkspace editor in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.

Prop-driven Event Publishing workspace surface used by the route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; canonical detail keeps lifecycle fields read-only with operator-facing rationale while backend paths and callable names stay in repository documentation.
Route wrapper owns TanStack Query controller; preview renders the registered FinanceOpsWorkspace with deterministic issue/reconciliation fixtures in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.
Prop-driven Finance Ops workspace surface used by the route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; controller-owned query logic stays in FinanceOpsScreen.

Finance route at /finance/commercial-terms and /finance/commercial-terms/organizers/{organizerId}; the wrapper owns the TanStack Query controller, and the preview renders the registered workspace with deterministic platform, history and override fixtures.

Prop-driven commercial terms workspace: platform defaults with revision history, the owner-decision starting draft, a reasoned field-by-field preview before save, and sparse organizer overrides whose unset terms read as inherited.
Finance route at /finance/payment-routing for the app routing policy; the wrapper owns the TanStack Query controller.

Prop-driven payment routing workspace: route and test/live mode per purpose, a preview against the saved revision, and typed confirmations before any purpose goes live, switches to the Route split, or turns off.
Route wrapper owns TanStack Query controller; preview renders the registered GrowthKpiWorkspace with deterministic signal/trend fixtures in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.
Prop-driven Growth KPI workspace surface used by the route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; controller-owned query logic stays in GrowthKpiScreen.
Tabbed route shell owns event, organizer, and read-only automation composition; previews use deterministic controller fixtures in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.
Prop-driven Intake workspace shell used by the route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; live event, organizer, and automation composition stays in IntakeWorkspaceScreen.
Live Event Intake hook wrapper registered for export governance; deterministic preview coverage belongs to workspace_event_intake via EventIntakePreviewWorkspace.
Live Supply Intake operations hook wrapper; deterministic preview coverage belongs to workspace_intake_operations.
Prop-driven read-only Supply Intake operations inventory backed by canonical run and work-item fixtures.

Organizer Intake live route wrapper delegates to OrganizerIntakeWorkspace with feedback providers; deterministic preview coverage includes a 30-item independently scrollable candidate queue and fail-closed organizer draft creation.

Prop-driven Organizer Intake workspace used by the live route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; reviewed candidates can create an unclaimed hidden draft while publication, indexing, crawling, and ownership remain disabled.
Marketing Ops route wrapper keeps live admin feedback props and delegates to MarketingOpsWorkspace; deterministic preview coverage uses typed synthetic dashboard state in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.
Prop-driven Marketing Ops workspace used by the live route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; generated dashboard state and no-op callbacks are supplied through the controller seam.

The editor the organizer page's Page tab hosts, and the claims review kept under Organizers until the Inbox decides claims. The Organizers directory replaced its directory list; deterministic preview coverage uses shared sample organizer details in AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.

Prop-driven Organizer Publishing workspace used by the route wrapper and deterministic Storybook previews; the canonical editor, the stateful blocked-draft editor, route readiness, and actionable publishing blockers come from shared sample organizer fixtures without backend implementation telemetry.

Needs you: every overview queue item waiting on a person in one list, oldest first, beside counts by kind and data-source freshness, in the quiet register on CatchWorkspaceHeader and CatchPaneLayout feed. Rows open the role-checked owning area. It replaces the Overview action digest.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the Needs you controller/query seam; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_now.

The Intake inbox: listings, imported events, claims, enquiries, launch access and stuck intake in one oldest-first queue with real totals per scope and type, on CatchWorkspaceHeader and CatchTable, with the selected item beside it on CatchPaneLayout queue: facts on CatchMetaRow, How it got here on the CatchSection timeline, and the decision on CatchDock pane. Ops recommend claims; the owner decides them.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the inbox controller/query seam; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_inbox.

Organizers: every listed organizer in one CatchTable on CatchPaneLayout wide-table with real totals from adminListOrganizerDirectory; CatchWorkspaceHeader carries the views (all, live, unclaimed, hidden), the city, kind, claim-waiting and Mine chips and search. It replaces the Organizer Publishing directory.

One organizer in the CatchPaneLayout reading pattern with CatchPageTabBar tabs Overview, Page, Events, Sales, Money and History, read from adminGetOrganizerOverview, with CatchMetaRow facts and the CatchSection timeline journey; the Page tab hosts the Organizer Publishing editor for this organizer.

Lazy live route wrapper owns the Organizers directory and organizer page controllers and keeps the claims review reachable until the Inbox decides claims; deterministic prop-driven coverage remains on route_organizer_directory and route_organizer_page.

Events: Catch and imported events in one CatchTable on CatchPaneLayout wide-table with exact view totals from adminListEventDirectory; each row names its source. It replaces the Event Publishing directory and External inventory.
One organizer's events, Catch and imported, for the Events tab of the organizer page.
One event in the CatchPaneLayout reading pattern: a Catch event's facts and bookings with a Page tab hosting the Event Publishing editor, or an imported event's facts, checks and source link.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the Events directory and event page controllers; the old External inventory address opens the directory filtered to imported events.
Live wrapper that reads one organizer's events for the organizer page's Events tab; coverage remains on workspace_organizer_events.

Marketplace analytics, split from the old Overview (its queues moved to Needs you): range and entity controls apply to host analytics. The Marketplace board (PR 14) replaces it. Backed by sample host analytics fixtures in admin/src/stories/AdminRoutes.stories.tsx.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the Marketplace analytics controller/query seam; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_marketplace.
Role-gated route wrapper loads the bounded score-free showcase queue and keeps all server mutations behind the pending-operation guard.
Prop-driven reviewer workspace shows public profile evidence, coarse objective blockers, fingerprint state, and audited approve, hold, or pause decisions.

Safety in the quiet register (boards AdminSafety and AdminSafetyActions): open cases from every queue, launch access included, due soonest first in a CatchTable on the CatchPaneLayout queue pattern; account actions and appeals as views of the same workspace header. The case beside the queue carries its facts, evidence and the resolve or dismiss decision, and opens the act-on-an-account sheet. It replaces the Safety triage and Launch access screens.

The act-on-an-account sheet (board AdminSafetyAction) on CatchSheet: warn, restrict, suspend and ban as CatchChoiceTile choices (suspend and ban owner-only), how long, the rule broken from Settings → Safety, the message the person sees, and whether the reporter hears it was handled and whether the person may appeal.

Lazy live route wrapper owns the Safety triage, launch access, account action, settings and action-sheet controllers and the URL seam; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_safety.
